svg.text: LQABR Agent Gateway — dataflow: HubSpot trigger → Email / Voice / Scheduling agents
SP-1 · Rev 3 · trigger-only routing, no lead data crosses the gateway · verified live 31 Jul + 4 Aug 2026 on real CRM records
1 filter property + value must match a route
3 loop guard agent's own write-back → drop
no name · no email · no phone
fetches the lead, places the Vapi call,
agents write status back to HubSpot → fires the next route (loop guard stops self-triggering)
on end: POSTs the transcript back
• body forwarded UNCHANGED — no router, no A2A envelope
• Google OIDC ID token attached (txtv is private)
Never route a lead by accident — every event has a terminal outcome
eventId already handed off, or the
matched but no endpoint, or dispatch
failed — NOT deduped, so HubSpot retries
something tried to attach lead data
to an A2A payload → fail loudly
nothing is relayed to the agent
Observability — FR-7, four JSON streams to stdout (Cloud Logging)

audit every inbound + outbound hop (source_ip, endpoint, status, latency) · process routing_decision with the property and value it was based on · system concurrency, config errors, exceptions · token-model silent — the gateway calls no model
keys: one run_id per request · one trigger_id per routed event, carried to the agent as x-lqabr-trigger-id · transcripts are never logged (profile-field guard)
✓ Verified live on real HubSpot records — no mocks upstream of the agent
31 Jul · contact 523828708059 · decision_maker true → R2 → email agent · signature_verified · 11.63 ms | 4 Aug · contact 530431312580 · lqabr_email_status OPENED → R3 → voice agent · 111.44 ms
